primary.name: investment-data-architecture-planner
primary.implementation_scope: AM grain/lineage and bitemporal sample resolution with declared license/access controls, shared architecture/value methods and optional approved read-only HTTPS gateway client; no source truth certification

supporting.name: investment-data-quality-reviewer
supporting.implementation_scope: Native quality and cross-source comparison modes; no live data platform

supporting.name: investment-reference-data-reviewer
supporting.implementation_scope: Eight-field reference-data proposals; no complete instrument master

supporting.name: research-source-indexer
supporting.implementation_scope: Supplied source metadata indexing; no retrieval or permission authentication

supporting.name: solution-architecture-planner
supporting.implementation_scope: Prepare provider-neutral component and interface designs with explicit alternatives, source/tool contracts, access and failure semantics, measured requirement fit and comparable period costs. Use for financial-services workload architecture; no production deployment, fabricated benchmarks or vendor certification.

supporting.name: data-lineage-documenter
supporting.implementation_scope: Document end-to-end data lineage, transformations, controls, owners, quality rules, retention, and source-to-output dependencies.

supporting.name: data-product-value-evaluator
supporting.implementation_scope: Evaluate a supplied data provider or product through licensed-purpose evidence, paired outcome-cost comparisons, classification errors, coverage and temporal leakage checks. Use for incremental data-value review; distinguish observed results from projections without selecting a provider or claiming causality.

plans.overlay_requirements: Point-in-time history, IBOR/ABOR, licenses, semantics and source ownership
